ai_provisions: Article 8.83(2)(i): the Parties agree to maintain a dialogue on regulatory matters relating to electronic commerce, including on 'emerging technology, including artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things'.
relevance.excluded_scope: AI is one item in a cooperative dialogue list. The Agreement creates no AI-specific prohibition, standard, market-access condition, enforcement mechanism or dedicated regulator.
relevance.reason: A binding bilateral comprehensive economic partnership agreement in force with an express AI reference in its electronic-commerce cooperation article. The reference is programmatic and does not create an AI-specific regime; the Agreement is not an AI-specific treaty.
